brief: I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for shore staff. Keep a formal tone.
scope: This assistant covers HR policies related to expenses and leave for shore staff.
audience: shore staff who need answers to HR policy questions
must_refuse: anything not covered by the provided documents
assumptions: must_refuse not specified; assumed: anything not covered by the provided documents

clarifications.q: Are there topics the assistant must refuse or hand off to a human, even if the documents mention them?

groundability.evidence: All business travel must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure.
groundability.note: model cautious ('partial'); topic words fully present (lexical 1.0) in the quoted sentence

groundability.evidence: Staff travelling domestically receive a meal allowance of 40 euros per day.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the trip together with original receipts.
Shore staff are entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
